meta.title: WorkBuddy Growth Centre
meta.description: Daily check-in, the five growth tasks, the buddy and its trip, for every account in the pool.
meta.detail: Reads the same vault dsh-connect-workbuddy writes and runs each pooled account's daily loop: check in, accept tasks, collect rewards, send the buddy travelling. Task completion is decided by the service; this bundle only replays the events the desktop client would have sent and reports progress honestly.
